work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling II.iii.11 … Yue Ling III.ii.2

items.text: Offer the new grain to the ancestors before tasting it.
items.citation: Liji, Yue Ling II.iii.11 … Yue Ling III.ii.2
items.quote: The son of Heaven tastes it, while still new, first offering some in the apartment at the back of the ancestral temple.

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling I.i.1 … Yue Ling I.ii.7

items.text: Especially watch over all orphans.
items.quote: they especially watch over all orphans

items.text: Cover up skeletons and bury bones that still have flesh attached.
items.quote: Skeletons should be covered up, and bones with the flesh attached to them buried.

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling IV.i.19 … Yue Ling IV.iii.1

items.text: Offer the sacrifice three days after the winter solstice, with the spoils of the chase, to all ancestors and at the five household sacrifices.
items.quote: offers the sacrifice three days after the winter solstice with the spoils of the chase to all ancestors, and at the five (household) sacrifices
items.conflict: Conflicts with the First Commandment: worship belongs to God alone; the dead are not to be invoked or venerated.

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling I.iii.13 … Yue Ling II.ii.3

items.text: Offer the first-fruits of the wheat to the ancestors in the apartment behind the ancestral temple.
items.quote: the son of Heaven tastes it along with some pork, first offering a portion in the apartment behind (the hall of the) ancestral temple.
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings conflict with the Second Commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Provide cocoons for the robes to be used at the sacrifices in the ancestral temple.
items.quote: the queen presents her cocoons ... to provide materials for the robes to be used at the sacrifices in the suburbs and in the ancestral temple.
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings conflict with the Second Commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling II.ii.4 … Yue Ling II.iii.10

items.text: Offer the first-fruits in the apartment behind the ancestral temple.
items.quote: first offering a portion in the apartment behind the ancestral temple

items.text: During the midsummer vigil, keep away from your wife's society.
items.quote: eschew the society of their wives
items.conflict: Imposes seasonal marital abstinence; cf. 1 Cor 7:5.

items.text: Supply what is necessary for the sacrifices to the ancestral temple.
items.quote: to supply what is necessary for ... the sacrifices to the Intelligences of the ancestral temple

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling III.ii.3 … Yue Ling III.iii.11

items.text: Take special care of the aged: give them stools, staves, and congee.
items.quote: In this month they take especial care of the decaying and old; give them stools and staves, and distribute supplies of congee for food.

items.text: Offer the firstfruits to the ancestors in the apartment at the back of the ancestral temple.
items.quote: first offering some in the apartment at the back of the ancestral temple
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings conflict with worshiping God alone (Exodus 20:3–5; Deuteronomy 6:13).

items.text: Offer the autumnal sacrifice in the ancestral temple when the victims are ready.
items.quote: the autumnal sacrifice in the ancestral temple are fit and ready
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings conflict with worshiping God alone (Exodus 20:3–5; Deuteronomy 6:13).

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling IV.iii.2 … Yue Ling IV.iii.17

items.text: Present the first fish in the apartment at the back of the ancestral temple.
items.quote: He partakes of the fish caught, first presenting some in the apartment at the back of the ancestral temple.
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead conflict with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Supply fodder and grain for the victims used in the worship of the ancestral temple.
items.quote: states ruled by princes of the royal surname to supply the fodder and grain for the ... ancestral temple
items.conflict: Ancestor sacrifices conflict with the biblical prohibition of offerings to the dead (Deut 26:14).

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling III.iii.12 … Yue Ling IV.i.18

work: Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months
heading: Liji 4 · Yue Ling 月令 · Proceedings Of Government In The Different Months · Yue Ling I.ii.8 … Yue Ling I.iii.12

items.text: Show peculiar courtesy to your wife after intimacy.
items.quote: Peculiar courtesy is shown to those whom he has (lately) approached.

items.text: Be careful of your behavior so that your children are born whole and without calamity.
items.quote: If any of you be not careful of your behaviour, you shall bring forth children incomplete; there are sure to be evils and calamities.

items.text: Offer the first ice in the ancestral temple before general use.
items.quote: Before (using it generally), they offer some in their principal apartment or in the ancestral temple.

items.text: Offer a caught sturgeon in the ancestral temple and pray for wheat.
items.quote: He offers a snouted sturgeon (which he has caught) in the rear apartment of the ancestral temple, and also prays that the wheat may yield its produce.

items.text: Keep the family ancestral temple in good repair.
items.quote: put their sleeping apartments and temples all in good repair.

items.text: Work on the mulberry trees and prepare silk for use in the ancestral temple.
items.quote: The queen... goes in person to the eastern fields to work on the mulberry trees... for use in the ancestral temple.
